Design a simple Flash memory cell controller that allows writing, reading, and erasing of a single cell. The controller should have the following functionalities:
1. A write enable signal (`we`) which, when high, allows data to be written to the memory cell.
2. A read enable signal (`re`) which, when high, allows data to be read from the memory cell.
3. An erase signal (`erase`) which, when high, resets the memory cell to 0.
4. An input data signal (`data_in`) for writing to the cell.
5. An output data signal (`data_out`) for reading from the cell.

The memory cell should retain its value until it is explicitly erased or written to.
code:
module flash_memory_cell (
    input wire clk,
    input wire we,
    input wire re,
    input wire erase,
    input wire data_in,
    output reg data_out
);
    reg memory_cell; // Internal memory storage

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (erase) begin
            memory_cell <= 1'b0; // Erase the cell
        end else if (we) begin
            memory_cell <= data_in; // Write to the cell
        end
    end

    always @(posedge clk) begin
        if (re) begin
            data_out <= memory_cell; // Read from the cell
        end
    end
endmodule
